{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Dark-wash straight-leg jeans, full length with a clean hem, deep indigo #1F2A44, stretch denim with a slight sheen-free finish. Wait, neat band calls for trousers rather than denim, so: Tailored wool trousers, straight leg, ankle-to-full length, charcoal navy #2B3245, midweight wool crepe.
Fine-gauge turtleneck sweater, slim fit, hip length, ivory #EDE6D8, merino wool.
Textured blazer, single-breasted, slightly relaxed fit, hip length, heather taupe #8B7E74, wool tweed.
Ankle boots, block heel about 4 cm, waterproof sole, round toe, dark brown #3B2A22, treated leather.
Long coat, belted-free straight cut, below the knee, with a storm collar, deep black-navy #1A1D26, water-repellent wool-blend twill.
Wide-brim-free compact umbrella, windproof, vented canopy, black #111111, nylon with fiberglass ribs.
Scarf, large and wrapped, rust #A5533A, soft lambswool.
Crossbody bag, structured, medium size, dark brown #3B2A22, grained leather with a zip closure.

This outfit works because the wool trousers and merino turtleneck keep you warm at 9 °C while staying neat enough for both the cinema and dinner afterwards. The tweed blazer adds texture and polish, and the long water-repellent coat with a storm collar handles the downpour and the wind. Waterproof-soled ankle boots keep your feet dry and steady on wet pavement, and the windproof umbrella is built for gusts. The rust scarf adds a warm accent against the neutral palette and can be tucked in or removed once you are seated."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2354,"output_tokens":595},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
